title: Fixed Points of Nonexpansive Maps in Reflexive Banach Spaces
summary: Every nonexpansive selfmap of a nonempty closed bounded convex subset of a real reflexive Banach space has a fixed point. This resolves the reflexive-space fixed point problem for the given norm.
family_title: Nonexpansive fixed points in reflexive Banach spaces

review.reason: Proves existence of fixed points for nonexpansive maps on reflexive Banach spaces.
